requirements.title: Production technical definition
requirements.statement: Released manufacturing definition shall unambiguously communicate functionally necessary size, fit, GD&T, material, finish, process and inspection characteristics without contradictory dimensions.

requirements.title: P007 material
requirements.statement: P007 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

requirements.title: J2 locating architecture
requirements.statement: J2 transverse location shall be controlled by the Ø14.10 H7/g6 pilot/locator pair and axial location by the metal mating faces; clamp screws shall not be redundant datum controls.

requirements.title: P007 overall length
requirements.statement: P007 overall length shall remain 35.0 mm for the C2R1 mechanical baseline.

requirements.title: J2 differential-pressure envelope
requirements.statement: J2/P007 qualification differential-pressure envelope shall be -0.20 ... +0.20 bar.
requirements.verification_method: Final P007 Static +0.20 bar; Buckling -0.20 bar; leak acceptance test

REQ-K01-ACT-FORCE-001.title: Actuator force coefficient
REQ-K01-ACT-FORCE-001.statement: Final electromagnetic design shall meet or exceed the released minimum force/force-coefficient envelope over stroke, current, temperature and production tolerances.

REQ-K01-TPD-001.title: Production technical definition
REQ-K01-TPD-001.statement: Released manufacturing definition shall unambiguously communicate functionally necessary size, fit, GD&T, material, finish, process and inspection characteristics without contradictory dimensions.
REQ-K01-TPD-001.verification_method: drawing semantic QA + visual QA + inspection-plan cross-check

REQ-K01-MEDIA-001.title: J2 media/cleaning envelope
REQ-K01-MEDIA-001.statement: Process gas, condensate and cleaning-media species that may contact J2 shall be bounded for elastomer qualification.
REQ-K01-MEDIA-001.verification_method: media specification + supplier compatibility statement + leak qualification

REQ-K01-SEAL-001.title: J2 static seal
REQ-K01-SEAL-001.statement: J2 shall use a static face seal architecture sized for the released media, temperature, pressure and service envelope.
REQ-K01-SEAL-001.verification_method: gland tolerance stack + compression-force qualification + leak test

REQ-K01-LEAK-001.title: Leak acceptance
REQ-K01-LEAK-001.statement: A quantitative J2 leak-test acceptance criterion shall be defined before production release.

REQ-K01-SERVICE-CYCLES-001.title: Repeated service life
REQ-K01-SERVICE-CYCLES-001.statement: Required number of J2/P006 service cycles shall be released; provisional 50-cycle screening is not itself a product requirement.

REQ-K01-J2-LOC-001.title: J2 locating architecture
REQ-K01-J2-LOC-001.statement: J2 transverse location shall be controlled by the Ø14.10 H7/g6 pilot/locator pair and axial location by the metal mating faces; clamp screws shall not be redundant datum controls.

REQ-K01-P007-L-001.title: P007 overall length
REQ-K01-P007-L-001.statement: P007 overall length shall remain 35.0 mm for the C2R1 mechanical baseline.

REQ-K01-MAT-P007-001.title: P007 material
REQ-K01-MAT-P007-001.statement: P007 production material shall be AISI 316L / EN 1.4404.

REQ-K01-ENV-DP-001.title: J2 differential-pressure envelope
REQ-K01-ENV-DP-001.statement: J2/P007 qualification differential-pressure envelope shall be -0.20 ... +0.20 bar.
REQ-K01-ENV-DP-001.verification_method: Final P007 Static +0.20 bar; Buckling -0.20 bar; leak acceptance test

REQ-K01-ENV-TEMP-001.title: J2 local temperature envelope
REQ-K01-ENV-TEMP-001.statement: For the current release, accepted CFD establishes J2 local temperature at 50-55 degC; use 55 degC as design maximum.
REQ-K01-ENV-TEMP-001.verification_method: Existing CFD is the controlled thermal basis; reopen only after a controlled geometry/flow/thermal-boundary change
